Remark
[the classical space-time Schwarzschild metric]

Source: petersen:page-0144 ↗ prop:pet-ch4-schwarzschild-ricci-flat Replacing $S^1$ by $\mathbb {R}$, treating the parameter $c$ (the speed of light) as independent of $\rho _0$, and passing to a Lorentzian signature gives the classical (non-Riemannian) Schwarzschild space-time metric \[ \frac1{1-\rho _0/\rho }\, d\rho ^2+\rho ^2ds_2^2-\frac1{c^2}\Big(1-\frac{\rho _0}\rho \Big)dt^2, \] which is not smooth at $\rho =\rho _0$.
